text:
Maya: Quick note  weekend we saw a spike in spend on longtail/search retargeting. CTR ok, conversions flat -> CPL up. Thinking: throttle weekend bids, push webinar promo to weekdays.
Sam: Numbers?
Maya: Weekend spend +50% vs baseline, convs +2% -> CPL +35%. Not huge volume but eats test budget.
Luis: Which audiences? new lists or existing retargeters?
Maya: Mostly 30-90d retargeting lists plus a couple broad-match expansions we turned on.
Priya: I support throttling. Also propose we swap creatives: run webinar-focused assets to mid-funnel retargeters (3-card carousel), CTA: "Product deep-dive + Q&A".
Tanya: I can write webinar copy. Who owns the landing page?
Alex: I can update ads. Need UTMs and lead-routing rules first.
Maya: Lead routing: HubSpot workflow -> SDR Queue A if MQL, else drip. Tag immediately: "webinar_apr", "channel:search".
Priya: UTM template to use across promos:
```
utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=webinar_apr&utm_term={keyword}&utm_content={creative}
```
Luis: For retargeting windows: test 7d recency (high intent) vs 30d. Historically 7d conv rate >30d.
Maya: Ok run 7d high-bid weekdays, keep 30d on lower bids/weekends.
Sam: Budget reallocation?
Maya: Shift 40% of weekend search budget to weekday 9-5 PST for 2 weeks, monitor CPL.
Alex: I'll create two ad groups: webinar_short_A and webinar_benefits_B. A = short copy, B = benefits-led. Also will add creative rotation every 72h.
Priya: Analytics: add event "webinar_reg" capturing utm_campaign so we can join impressions -> leads.
Tanya: Drafting email sequence for registrants. Also will include a slide that calls out Dedicated vs Private deployment benefits.
Maya: Include a one-line benchmark in confirmation email: "Teams typically see 30-50% lower inference cost within one month of Redwood Optimize"  Priya to iterate language.
Priya: I'll draft three variants for A/B.
JenkinsBot: pipeline:ad-update started by Alex. status: queued.
Alex: Landing page needs "company size" field for routing. Dev help?
Luis: I'll add the field + hidden utm_campaign by 12:30pm.
Sam: Reporting: need a dashboard card for CPL by daypart and by recency window (7d vs 30d).
Priya: I'll add GA4 card + internal dashboard. ETA EOD. Preview: https://dash.redwood.internal/webinar-cpl
Maya: If CPL improves >15% after 48h, reallocate extra 20% from weekend budget. Sync tomorrow 10am to review.
Alex: Creative push started.
Luis: Form change deployed.
Priya: Dashboard card live.
Tanya: Landing page draft posted to #marketing-review.
Sam: 44d
Maya: Thanks all, monitoring.
